purpose: Category-level research for Power / Grid and adjacent data-centre electrical infrastructure.
categoryRead: Power / Grid remains the highest-quality structural Power Stack category, but the investable map is widening from raw megawatts into reliability around the bottleneck. Utility T&D, substations, switchgear, transformers, cable and generation remain supported by data-centre and industrial load growth, while hyperscaler backup-power demand now validates generator packaging, UPS/power conditioning and service as a second-order scarcity layer. The bond market still strengthens the valuation-risk side: 10Y/30Y Treasury yields around 4.7%/5.25% penalise long-duration multiples, so prefer profitable equipment, engineering and reliability exposures with backlog, pricing power and free cash flow over leveraged or narrative-only power names.

regionalRead.US: GE Vernova, Eaton, Quanta and Hubbell remain the established quality core. The Aug 24 deep screen adds two differentiated adjacencies: Generac's data-centre backlog of roughly $1.6bn validates backup-power/reliability demand, while Belden's record orders and AI-data-centre/industrial-networking exposure create a lower-multiple physical-connectivity crossover. These do not replace the core hierarchy; they broaden the monetisation layer around constrained grid connections.
regionalRead.Europe: AI data-centre projects are moving farther from major cities toward sites with cheaper energy, land and faster grid connections. JLL data cited by Reuters shows 2026-28 hyperscale projects averaging about 175 km from urban centres versus 46 km in 2022-25. Power availability and interconnection speed are increasingly determining geography, strengthening the grid/generation thesis beyond US hyperscaler capex alone.
regionalRead.HongKongChina: China kept the 1Y/5Y LPR at 3.00%/3.50%, signalling reliance on fiscal infrastructure execution rather than broad monetary reflation. Keep emphasis on state-backed power, grid, nuclear and equipment buildout rather than generic domestic cyclicals. ASMPT is tracked separately as an AI packaging/photonics equipment adjacency rather than a power name.
regionalRead.Malaysia: The data-centre buildout continues to translate into real 275kV substation, cable and high-voltage work. TNB remains the lower-beta regulated expression; Southern Cable, MN Holdings and CBH offer higher operating leverage with greater project concentration and working-capital risk. The deeper screen did not find a genuinely new Malaysia power/grid core name; Ranhill remains a water-infrastructure watch rather than a grid promotion.

priorityHierarchy: GNRC — new reliability/backup-power research candidate; direct hyperscaler backlog
SCGBHD / MNHLDG / CBHB — Malaysia higher-beta grid-connection layer

candidateRead.GNRC: New 8.4 priority-research candidate. Q2 C&I growth and roughly $1.6bn of data-centre backlog validate the power-reliability theme, but residential cyclicality, capacity-ramp execution and a roughly 20x-forward-earnings valuation keep it below the established GEV/PWR/ETN core.
candidateRead.BDC: New 8.5 priority-research candidate. Record Q2 orders, 1.11 book-to-bill and explicit AI-data-centre/physical-AI commentary make it a differentiated connectivity/industrial-networking crossover with less valuation duration than many optical leaders. RUCKUS integration and leverage require follow-up.
candidateRead.CBHB: Maintains 7.9 priority-candidate status after strong earnings/order evidence. No upgrade today because data-centre concentration, short listing history and entry-price risk still require more proof.
candidateRead.ROK: Not a Power/Grid pure play, but warehouse/data-centre automation demand makes it a useful adjacent industrial-capex confirmation.

newAdjacency.name: Power reliability around the bottleneck
newAdjacency.mechanism: Large AI loads make grid availability only part of the problem. Backup generation, UPS, switchgear, voltage regulation, power conditioning, control systems and maintenance gain value when hyperscalers need uninterrupted power despite interconnection constraints and abrupt load changes.
